objective: The coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-26 on the first direction of HOW-MUCH-ARRIVES-20261126-001 after its referee: under ordinary growth only (a short start knot stalls the round), compare every pair of small census starts of one kind of growth (one dimension, or one rate) in the two readings without names (each birth by its kind, parents, fresh distinctions and places, and with its parents' as well), and find the round from which each pair agrees up to the count, or that it never does. Stop at a criterion, found on starts of at most four knots and frozen, that predicts each pair of a held-out sample of five-knot starts, or at a pair it misses.
status: Complete 2026-11-26 (referee pending): under ordinary growth every census start of one to five knots of a fixed dimension settles, for a local reader, into a late view of a few kinds of birth counted by polynomials; settled views decide which starts agree up to the count; the frozen settling bound missed seven five-knot starts whose block of ten bursts to round 11 (the stop, met at that miss).
